LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public personal-best survival run record for a verified player on the Nightfall Courtyard global leaderboard.

uid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the document ID.

wave.description: Highest wave reached in the recorded run (1..999).

kills.description: Total infected eliminated in the recorded run (0..1000000).

equippedGear.description: Tactical gear equipped during the run.

isPublic.description: Always true; enables rule-enforced public leaderboard list queries.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when player first joined the leaderboard.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest personal best update.

/leaderboard/{entryId}.description: Global personal-best high score entries keyed by the verified player UID.
